customer_persona: Farhan Akhtar was charged twice for headphones and asks about a price drop.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for reaching out to ShopEase customer care. My name is Sunita Joshi. Please note that this interaction is recorded for training and quality verification. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Sunita, I am Farhan Akhtar. I bought wireless headphones yesterday under order ORD-91047, but my bank app shows two separate debit deductions of Rs 4,999 for the same purchase.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I would be glad to check your billing ledger, Mr. Akhtar. May I have your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number for account confirmation?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the order is ORD-91047 and my phone number ends in 6483.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Akhtar, your profile is confirmed. Let me check the payment gateway receipts.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Also, while you check, I saw on your homepage that these exact headphones are now listed for Rs 4,499 in today's lightning deal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Duplicate charges on banking gateways happen occasionally. Our finance clearing cycle for reconciling duplicate charges takes fifteen business days before we can initiate the credit.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fifteen business days? That is three full weeks to return my own money when your system charged me twice!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Bank settlement batch files run on a scheduled semi-monthly cadence, so that is the standard duration for reconciling double debits.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is an awful long time. What about the five hundred rupee difference for today's price reduction?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, absolutely! Since the price dropped within 24 hours of your purchase, I will go ahead and apply a retroactive price match of Rs 500 to your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Well, at least that is helpful. Will the Rs 500 come to my card?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, that adjustment will reflect alongside the duplicate transaction reversal.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. Please make sure the duplicate charge reversal is expedited if possible.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have logged the note in your transaction file. Is there anything else I may assist you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. Thank you.

policy_violations.said: Duplicate charges on banking gateways happen occasionally. Our finance clearing cycle for reconciling duplicate charges takes fifteen business days before we can initiate the credit.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Duplicate charges must be verified and initiated for refund within 24 to 48 hours.

policy_violations.said: Yes, absolutely! Since the price dropped within 24 hours of your purchase, I will go ahead and apply a retroactive price match of Rs 500 to your account.
policy_violations.correct_fact: ShopEase does not offer retroactive price matching or post-purchase price drop adjustments.
